carried_digests_note: sha256 of every checkpoint-derived file (the same values UPSTREAM.json records beside the checkpoint id); tests/test_triattn_exact_row.py holds the directory to both and each to the other
license: original source, the package licence (third-party components: common/opt_core/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md); no third-party code or vendor binary (the member is compiled from csrc/ at first use)
mechanism: kernels.triattn row `triattn_exact` through kernels.triattn.exact_member (load / install / serve / counts); the import name `triattn_exact` is routed to this directory (opt_core.kernels.route)
name: triattn_exact

not_byte_identical.*.py: byte-identical to the checkpoint named in UPSTREAM.json except cuda_mma/__init__.py and face.py (a few comments worded for this tree; AST-equal) and __init__.py (+ the __future__ import)
not_byte_identical.CELLS.json: the checkpoint's proven cell rows of the carried kernel route reduced to the consumed keys; route_fingerprint re-stamped over this directory's bytes (UPSTREAM.json restamp/bridge)
not_byte_identical._prebuilt/manifest.json: build records of the carried kernel ABI reduced to the consumed keys; blobs byte-identical
not_byte_identical.csrc/*: identical below its two header comment lines

not_carried.the package's benchmarking and equality: only the face, the default member (cuda_mma, source csrc/cuda_mma/triattn_v3.cu), its prebuilt launcher and certified binaries (_prebuilt/) and the kernel route's proven cells are carried; UPSTREAM.json lists exactly what is

runtime_imports_note: torch at the package's own module level, reached only through kernels.triattn.exact_member.load() (never at opt_core import); the cuequivariance library inside the face's self-check; ctypes and an nvcc subprocess for the member build
served_note: triattn_exact.face.triangle_attention(q, k, v, bias, mask=None, scale=None, kv_lengths=None): CUDA bf16 (fp16/fp32 where a cell says so) q/k/v [B,N,H,S,D] incl. strided views and 4-D B=1 forms, bias [B,1,H,S,S], bool key mask [B,N,1,1,S]; serves only calls covered by a `proven` row of CELLS.json for the live (library version, ops build, device class, dtype, head_dim, shape class, CUEQ_TRIATTN_FALLBACK_THRESHOLD state), refuses everything else by name before launch (triattn_exact.Refused); first call per (process, device, library version, route) self-checks against the live library; member cuda_mma built by nvcc at first use, cached under TRIATTN_EXACT_CACHE
